§ 481-484 ]     CONJUGATION OF VERBS.     301

§ 481. ङ is to be prefixed, or not, or optionally to the terminations given above, according as the root is Set or Anit or Wet. Before the terminations the final vowel and the penultimate short take their Guna substitute.

§ 482. In the Conditional the augment अ is prefixed to the root as in the Imperfect.

                IRREGULAR BASES.

§ 483. गम् P. हन् and Anit roots ending in क्र admit ङ in the Second Future and the Conditional: गम् P ( also that substituted for दृ 'to go' and with आधि 'to remember' ) also admits it in the Desiderative: गमिष्यामि, हनिष्यामि, करिष्यामि, &c. Sec. Fu. 1. sing. अगमिष्यम्, अकरिष्यम्, अहनिष्यम्, &c. Con. 1. sing.
